figures.finding: Trinidad and Tobago's Production Expenditure Rebate Programme, run by FilmTT, pays international productions 12.5% (budgets US$100,000-499,999), 15% (US$500,000-999,999) or 35% (US$1-8 million) of qualifying spend, and local producers a flat 35% (US$15,000-8 million), each plus 20% on local labour; the ministry put the ceiling at TT$51.2 million of spend.
figures.applies: Trinidad and Tobago; tiers as reported to UNESCO in 2023

sources.said: 12.5% cash back on qualifying expenses for budgets us$100,000 – us$499,999, plus 20% cash back for hiring local labour … 35% cash back on qualifying expenses for budgets us$1,000,000 – $8,000,000 … a flat 35% cash back on qualifying expenses for budgets us$15,000 – us$8,000,000, plus 20% for hiring local labour
the Film Rebate offers a tiered system of 12.5% to 35% rebate on a minimum expenditure of TT$630,000 up to a maximum of TT$51,200,000 for foreign production companies
